gaps.sentence: She left the room without ___ goodbye.
This new timetable will mean ___ earlier trains.
Don't forget ___ off the lights when you leave.
gaps.explanation: forget + to-infinitive = fail to do a duty: forget to turn.

gaps.sentence: Do you have any idea how ___ this knot?
gaps.explanation: question word + to-infinitive: how to undo.

gaps.sentence: The teacher advised us ___ the essay twice.
gaps.explanation: advise + object + to-infinitive: advised us to check. (advise + -ing is possible without object: advise checking.)

gaps.sentence: I was made ___ the dustbin lorry at six in the morning.
gaps.explanation: In the passive, make takes the to-infinitive: was made to wait.

gaps.sentence: I'm looking forward to ___ from you.
gaps.explanation: 'to' is a preposition in look forward to, so -ing follows: hearing.

gaps.sentence: Would you like ___ now or later?
gaps.explanation: would like takes the to-infinitive: would like to eat.
